facts.text: UND's John D. Odegard School of Aerospace Sciences operates one of the largest civilian aircraft fleets in North America.

sources.title: John D. Odegard School of Aerospace Sciences | University of North Dakota
sources.quote: The second-largest degree-granting college at UND, the John D. Odegard School of Aerospace Sciences operates one of the largest fleets of civilian aircraft in North America.
